$comment: ADR-338: AI defends its OWN claimed territory with barbed wire and turrets. All knobs live here, not in code. Threat is a score over recent events near home (zombie sightings, kills, livestock losses, a recent close attack); the level is how many of levelThresholds the score reaches. Defence building starts at buildThreatLevel and only with surplus materials: after paying a piece's cost, at least surplusReserve of each cost item must remain (0 for unlisted items), and no cost item may still be on the survival ladder's gather list. Wire goes first, along the claim perimeter (wireSlots evenly spaced angles, radius = claim radius - wireRingInset, capped at maxWire); then one turret of each kind in turretOrder order (cheapest first), at the turretOffsets around the base anchor, capped at maxTurrets. ADR-342: turret ammo stocking — a turret below ammoLowFraction of ammoTargetCount rounds is restocked to the target from the bot's bag or its own/employer base storage (mayTakeFromStorage rules), depositing only the surplus above the per-kind surplusReserve so the bot never gives away its last arrows/oil; one trip per turret, ammoCooldownTicks between trips, unclaimed boxes only within ammoHomeTiles of the home centre.
